figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Proposed mechanism for the AbmM-catalyzed reaction. RS
cluster indicates the radical SAM [Fe4S4] cluster. CIP: calf intestinal
alkaline phosphatase for removal of 5′-phosphates; compound 7 is
cytidine.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. (A) Reaction scheme and (B) HPLC analysis of the
selenium-for-oxygen swapping reaction catalyzed by Se-AbmM.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. (A) Experimental and (B) theoretical (predicted by
ChemDraw) mass spectra of the species eluting at 12.5 min (14). (C)
1H NMR (600 MHz) spectrum of 14 in D2O at 4 °C. Assignments
are shown for both the major and minor (in parentheses) isomers.
Chemical shifts of C1′ and C4′ in 14 and 9 are also shown.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. (A) Scheme of the AbmG-catalyzed reaction with 9 or 14.
C indicates cytosine. (B) HPLC analysis of the AbmG reaction using
14 as the substrate. Compound 14 appears as a pair of peaks,
presumably corresponding to the two 4′-epimers.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. Schemes of the AbmH-catalyzed reactions with (A) 21 or
(B) 22. C indicates cytosine. Compounds 21 and 22 are each found
as an equilibrium mixture of two epimers due to nonenzymatic keto−
enol tautomerization. (C) HPLC analysis of the AbmG-AbmH
coupled reaction using 14 as the substrate.
